parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: Date and time, based on {{bibref|RFC3339}}, that the {{object}} instance is to begin operation.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: Date and time, based on {{bibref|RFC3339}}, that the {{object}} instance is to end operation.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description: The tolerable duration, in {{units}}, of the interval for this {{object}} instance.

object.description: This object defines a periodic timer instance. The periodic timer instance has attributes for when the timer is to begin ({{param|StartTime}}) and end ({{param|EndTime}}) as well as the interval to use.
